target.statement: Residual GCN improves spatial-failure MAE by 0.0391 (95% hierarchical interval 0.0151–0.0662) on the expanded zero-shot OSM panel (13 areas).
target.table_ref: Table 5, row GCN, column Spatial cluster
target.dataset: 13 cached OpenStreetMap road networks (48–1,259 nodes) in six Asian countries, with synthetic training graphs

compute.basis: The paper reports CPU-only training (PyTorch CPU, 16 logical cores) with tiny graphs (≤1,259 nodes) and small models (~10k parameters); the expanded zero-shot protocol trains on 400 synthetic scenarios per mode and evaluates 20 scenarios per area/mode/seed across 13 areas, which should take well under an hour on a laptop, plus install and data download.

title: When does a spectral prior help graph learning? Connectivity-loss estimation under road-network disruptions
